description: Search the Idaho Statutes BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "landlord security deposit", "concealed weapon permit", "child custody". Matches against the Idaho Legislature's own official chapter and section CATCHLINES across all ~20,400 sections (not full statutory prose — Idaho does not publish a keyless full-text search API, verified live; its hosted search box has no documented contract). Returns matching citations and catchlines; call id_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

name: id_search
title: Id Search
